overview: Global headlines cover environmental damage following a capsized tanker near Ibiza and an explosion at a Bangkok oil refinery. In commercial real estate, tight supply and higher interest rates continue to shape project financing and market dynamics. San Francisco news features the resignation of a city department head amid a conflict of interest probe. Meanwhile, Hawaii faces extreme weather with high surf warnings and potential vog levels from volcanic activity.

items.title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
items.summary: A diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsized near Ibiza, leaving one person dead as Spain's sea rescue service assesses potential environmental damage.

items.title: Nine injured, three critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion
items.summary: An explosion at a Bangkok oil refinery left nine people injured, three critically, and sent black smoke billowing across the city skyline.

items.title: In Long Island Real Estate in 2027, Tight Supply Will Be a Key Driver
items.summary: As 2027 approaches, tighter lending standards and higher interest rates are placing additional pressure on real estate development and project financing on Long Island.

items.title: Flight to Quality Deepens Divide Among Major U.S. Office Markets
items.summary: The national office vacancy rate declined 140 basis points annually to 17.2 percent in October as a flight to quality deepens the divide among major U.S. cities.

items.title: Kate Sofis resigns as head of San Francisco War Memorial amid city probe
items.summary: Kate Sofis resigned as head of the San Francisco War Memorial following a special board meeting and an ongoing investigation into her performance.

items.title: SF city department head resigns amidst conflict of interest probe
items.summary: The resignation of Kate Sofis marks the latest controversy involving a city official connected to former Mayor London Breed's administration.

items.title: High surf warning extended as waves up to 45 feet pound Hawaii’s north shores
items.summary: An extended high surf warning brings waves up to 45 feet to Hawaii's north shores alongside summit winds reaching up to 115 mph.

items.title: Hawaii health officials warn of possible elevated vog levels
items.summary: Hawaii health officials warn the public to take precautions regarding elevated vog levels driven by the ongoing Kilauea volcano eruption.

wiki.title: Tabancale language
wiki.extract: Tabancale is an extinct language formerly spoken in the village of Aconipa, located along the Chinchipe River in the Department of Cajamarca, Peru, as well as in neighboring Ecuador, by the Tabancale people. Only five words were collected in the 16th century and they are not demonstrably related to those in other languages. As a result, it has been categorized as a language isolate by some and left unclassified by others; a connection has been proposed with the Chicham languages, spoken in Peru and Ecuador. The Tabancale people are thought to have switched to Quechua after they were conquered in 1549.
